method_name: Cross-fitted log-linear Poisson point-process model of the 4-7 e- rate density (static multiscale rate maps from other acquisitions + same-image high-energy-trail and single-electron covariates); mask = pixels with predicted rate above a threshold
split_strategy: Acquisition-level split (both modules and all 4 HDUs of an image number stay together). Development: acquisitions 22-97 (76), 4 contiguous chronological folds for cross-validation, model/feature/threshold selection; static maps cross-fitted so no image contributes to its own covariates. Held-out test: acquisitions 98-130 (33 acquisitions, 65 files after the quality cut), evaluated once with the frozen model and threshold.

selected_hyperparameters.selection_rule:
Stage 3b: summarise the dev cross-validation and fix the model + operating point.

Pre-declared rules (written before the CV results were seen):
  model:  minimise S = mean_{f in 0.80..0.99 step 0.01} log r_B(f)  (pooled out-of-fold, dev only)
          among the supervised intensity models (glm_*, hgb_*); iforest/intercept-only are comparators.
  point:  among thresholds with f_exp >= 0.5, F_max = max F_equal; choose the largest f_exp with
          F_equal >= 0.95 F_max. The threshold is stored as an absolute predicted rate density
          (log events / pixel-day) and applied unchanged to the held-out test block.

notes: ROI = 8-connected clusters with integer total charge 4..7 e- (pixel charge floor(q+0.5)); a cluster is kept if its charge-weighted centroid pixel is unmasked. Exposure per pixel from the continuous-readout time map. The test block baseline differs from the whole-dataset baseline (see whole_dataset_baseline). S101 HDU0 carries ~73% of baseline 4-7 e- clusters; see sanity_checks.without_S101_HDU0. git_commit is the commit checked out when this summary was generated (the code commit); results are committed in a following commit.
